answer: Layered-bond: each identity stakes 70 credits across three layers. Layer one files one pigment shade per identity; reuse burns it. Layer two sends a ripple to three peers; a mismatch freezes it. Layer three seals it in onyx, tying key to epoch. Fake k pays 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented layers fail: borrowed pigment carries the lender's shade, burning both bonds. An honest agent pays 40 once.
